itens.resumo: Now that Reality Fracture's out in the wild, it's time to take a deep dive into the mechanics of the set, both official and otherwise.

itens.titulo: What Do You Salt? A Guide to Each Color's Flavor of Salt
itens.resumo: Each color of the pie is known for a "thing" - the one aspect of Magic its best at. But does each color also have a distinct flavor of salt, too?
With a focus on planeswalkers, Reality Fracture brings with it a ton of new toys for Carth the Lion, a Golgari-colored 'walker-loving legend.
